story.iWant: a quick emoji-based mood check-in with optional notes
story.soThat: I can track how sessions make me feel without interrupting my flow or writing lengthy reflections

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Modal appears within 200ms of session end (track finishes OR user stops). Contains heading "How do you feel now?", 5-emoji grid, notes textarea, Submit/Skip buttons. Body scroll disabled while modal open. Auto-dismisses after 60 seconds.

5 emojis displayed horizontally (vertical stack on mobile <600px). Each emoji button is 80px+ tap target (WCAG 2.1 AA). Emojis: Anxious, Neutral, Calm, Focused, Energized with semantic labels. Selected state: bold border, aria-pressed="true". Click toggles selection.
Placeholder: "Optional notes (e.g., what helped?)". Max 500 chars with counter. Multiline support (3 rows). Can submit with or without emoji/notes. Empty notes stored as empty string (not null).

Submit: calls updateSession(sessionId, {moodAfter, notes}), shows toast "Session saved", closes modal. Skip: does NOT update session, closes modal, shows toast "Check-in skipped". Escape key: same behavior as Skip. Console logging for both actions.

Modal: role="dialog", aria-modal="true", aria-labelledby, aria-describedby. Emoji buttons: aria-label "Rate mood as [label]", aria-pressed for selected. Focus trap: Tab/Shift+Tab cycles within modal. Initial focus on first emoji. After close: focus returns to previous element (play/pause button).
No fade-in animation (instant display). No emoji scale animation on hover. No slide-in for notes textarea. Immediate modal close (no fade-out).

constraints.constraint: IndexedDB update must complete in <30ms P95
Modal render must complete in <100ms from trigger
All session data remains local - no network transmission
Emoji buttons must be 80px+ tap targets (WCAG 2.1 AA)
Auto-dismiss after 60 seconds if no interaction
Focus must return to previous element after modal close
Follow SavePresetDialog component patterns for modal structure
Reuse .dialog-overlay CSS class for consistent styling
Use same toast notification patterns as Story 3-3

tests.standards: Tests use Node.js with fake-indexeddb for unit testing IndexedDB operations. Manual browser testing required for modal interactions, accessibility, and reduced motion. Run existing tests via: npm test (includes session-logging.test.js). Accessibility audit with axe DevTools and Pa11y CLI targeting 95%+ score. Test on Chrome, Firefox, Safari desktop and iOS Safari, Android Chrome mobile.
